phrases.usage: 表示处于某个活动、状态或事业的顶峰、最鼎盛时期

examples.en: He was at the height of his career when he won the Nobel Prize.
examples.zh: 获得诺贝尔奖时，他正处于事业的顶峰。

examples.en: At the height of the summer, the temperature can reach 40℃ here.
examples.zh: 在盛夏时节，这里的温度可达40摄氏度。

phrases.usage: 表示某事物被设计、计划用于某个特定目的，主语通常是物

examples.en: This program is intended to help people with low income.
examples.zh: 这个项目旨在帮助低收入人群。

examples.en: The book is intended for children aged 5 to 10.
examples.zh: 这本书是为5到10岁的儿童编写的。

phrases.usage: 表示在某个领域、活动中起主导作用、担任重要角色

examples.en: She played a leading role in organizing the event.
examples.zh: 她在组织这次活动中起到了主导作用。

examples.en: China plays a leading role in global climate change cooperation.
examples.zh: 中国在全球气候变化合作中发挥着重要的引领作用。

phrases.usage: 用于描述大量丰富多彩、种类繁多的事物，尤指颜色

examples.en: The garden is a riot of colour in spring.
examples.zh: 春天的花园里色彩缤纷，万紫千红。

examples.en: The parade was a riot of sound and movement as dancers and musicians passed by.
examples.zh: 当舞者和音乐家经过时，游行队伍充满了喧闹的声响和活跃的身影。

phrases.usage: 表示激发、唤起某人的想象力

examples.en: Science fiction stories always stir children's imagination about space.
examples.zh: 科幻故事总能激发孩子们对太空的想象力。

examples.en: The mysterious ancient ruins stirred the archaeologists' imagination.
examples.zh: 这些神秘的古代遗迹唤起了考古学家的想象。

phrases.usage: 表示作为对……的回应、答复

examples.en: He nodded in reply to my question.
examples.zh: 他点了点头，作为对我问题的回应。

examples.en: The company issued a statement in reply to the media's accusations.
examples.zh: 公司发布了一则声明，回应媒体的指控。

phrases.usage: 表示决定了某人或某事物的最终结局（通常是不幸的），无法再改变

examples.en: His careless mistake in the final game sealed the team's fate.
examples.zh: 他在决赛中那个粗心的失误注定了球队的败局。

examples.en: When the company lost its biggest client, its fate was sealed.
examples.zh: 当公司失去了最大的客户时，它的命运就已经注定了。

grammar.title: 非限制性定语从句
grammar.definition: 对主句中某个名词或整个主句的内容进行补充说明，去掉后不影响主句的完整意思，通常和主句之间用逗号隔开 用于补充额外信息，而非限定修饰的对象，翻译时通常拆分为独立的句子

examples.en: In that first glorious hour, the mighty Vasa, which was intended to rule the Baltic, sank with all flags flying.
examples.zh: 在那荣耀的第一个小时里，本打算统治波罗的海的强大的“瓦萨”号，却在自己的诞生港内，全旗飘扬地沉入了海底。

examples.en: The old building, which was built in 1890, will be turned into a museum next year.
examples.zh: 这栋老建筑建于1890年，明年将被改造成一座博物馆。

grammar.title: with的复合结构作伴随状语
grammar.structure: with + 名词/代词 + 现在分词/过去分词/形容词/副词/介词短语/不定式
grammar.definition: 用"with + 宾语 + 宾语补足语"的结构，描述主句动作发生时的伴随状态、背景或原因 用于丰富句子的场景描述，让多个动作或状态同时呈现，避免堆砌多个简单句

examples.en: As she emerged from her drifting cloud of gun smoke with the water churned to foam beneath her bow, her flags flying, pennants waving, sails filling in the breeze, and the red and gold of her superstructure ablaze with colour, she presented a more majestic spectacle than Stockholmers had ever seen before.
examples.zh: 当它从弥漫的炮烟中驶出时，船首下的海水翻滚着泡沫，旗帜飘扬，三角旗舞动，风帆在微风中胀满，上层建筑的红金两色光彩夺目，它呈现出斯德哥尔摩人前所未见的雄伟景象。

examples.en: She walked into the classroom with a book in her hand and a smile on her face.
examples.zh: 她走进教室，手里拿着一本书，脸上带着微笑。

grammar.title: 时间状语从句的省略
grammar.structure: when/while/as/once/until/if等 + 现在分词/过去分词/形容词/介词短语
grammar.definition: 当时间状语从句的主语和主句主语一致，且从句包含be动词时，可以省略从句的主语和be动词，简化句子结构 用于避免重复主语，让句子更简洁紧凑

examples.en: As prepared for her maiden voyage on August 10, 1628, Stockholm was in a ferment.
examples.zh: 1628年8月10日，当它正准备首次航行时，斯德哥尔摩全城沸腾。

examples.en: When asked about his plan, he said he would go abroad for further study.
examples.zh: 当被问及他的计划时，他说他会出国深造。

translation:
1628年，一艘大帆船在处女航时就沉没了，这个从容不迫7世纪瑞典帝国流传至今的故事无疑是航海史上最离奇的事件之一。这艘大船在斯德哥尔摩港口的海底躺了将近几年来个世纪之后，直到1956年才被发现。这就是“瓦萨”号，帝国大舰的皇家旗舰。
当时号称“北方飓风”的国王古斯夫斯.阿道尔弗正处在“三十年战争”的军事鼎盛阶段，他亲自规定了这艘船的规模和武器配备。3层的火炮甲板上装着眼点4门青铜加农炮，目的就是要在不断增长的瑞典势力中起主导作用。
1628年8月10日，“瓦萨”号准备首航时，斯德哥尔摩一片欢腾。人们从斯开波斯布朗和周围的岛屿前来观着这艘美丽的战船扬帆起航，乘风前进。瑞典人辛辛苦苦干了3年才建成这件水上艺术品，它比以往任何船只雕刻得都更加精美，装饰得都更加华丽。高耸的船楼上雕刻了令人眼花缭乱的神仙、妖魔、骑士、国王、武士、美人鱼和小天使，还有用红色、金黄色、蓝色绘制的光彩夺目的兽形图案，象征着勇敢、力量和残暴，以激起汉时崇尚迷信的水手们的想像。
这时，停泊在港口的其他战船向“瓦萨”号鸣炮致礼，“瓦萨”号也鸣炮回礼。当“瓦萨”号从弥漫的礼炮烟云中出现时，船头下浪花加溅，舰旗迎风招展，三角旗随风飘动，微风鼓起风帆，金碧辉煌的船楼闪耀着灿烂的色彩。“瓦萨”号展现的壮观景象是斯德哥尔摩人从未见过的。船上的炮眼开着，炮口虎视眈眈地向外窥视着。
当风力增强时，突然刮来一阵大风，“瓦萨”号奇怪地摇晃了一下，便向左舷倾斜。炮长命令把左舷上所有大炮搬到右舷上来以抵消船的倾斜，但甲板的倾斜度仍在增加。当物口、压舱物、弹药和400个人轰地一声滑向陡斜的左舷时，岸上的观众听到了雷鸣般的轰响。下层炮眼已淹没在水里，涌进船舱的水给“瓦萨”号带来了难以逃脱的厄运。就这样，想要统治波罗的海的大型战舰“瓦萨”号，在它壮丽的起航时刻，带着全身飘扬的彩旗，沉没在了它诞生的港口。

lines.en: From the seventeenth-century empire of Sweden, the story of a galleon that sank at the start of her maiden voyage in 1628 must be one of the strangest tales of the sea.
For nearly three and a half centuries she lay at the bottom of Stockholm harbour until her discovery in 1956.
This was the Vasa, royal flagship of the great imperial fleet.
King Gustavus Adolphus, 'The Northern Hurricane', then at the height of his military success in the Thirty Years' War, had dictated her measurements and armament.
Triple gun-decks mounted sixty-four bronze cannon .
She was intended to play a leading role in the growing might of Sweden.
As she was prepared of her maiden voyage on August 10, 1628, Stockholm was in a ferment .
From the Skeppsbron and surrounding islands the people watched this thing of beauty begin to spread her sails and catch the wind.
They had laboured for three years to produce this floating work of art; she was more richly carved and ornamented than any previous ship.

The high stern castle was a riot of carved gods, demons , knights , kings, warriors , mermaids , cherubs ; and zoomorphic animal shapes ablaze with rea and gold and blue, symbols of courage, power, and cruelty, were portrayed to stir the imaginations of the superstitious sailors of the day.
Then the cannons of the anchored warships thundered a salute to which the Vasa fired in reply.
As the emerged from her drifting cloud of gun smoke with the water churned to foam beneath her bow, her flags colour, she presented a more majestic spectacle than Stockholmers had ever seen before.
All gun-ports were open and the muzzles peeped wickedly from them.
As the wind freshened there came a sudden squall and the ship made a strange movement, listing to port.
The Ordnance Officer ordered all the port cannon to be heaved to starboard to counteract the list, but the steepening angle of the decks increased.
Then the sound of rumbling thunder reached the watchers on the shore, as cargo , ballast, ammunition and 400 people went sliding and crashing down to the port side of the steeply listing ship.
The lower gun-ports were now below water and the inrush sealed the ship's fate.
In that first glorious hour, the mighty Vasa, which was intended to rule the Baltic, sank with all flags flying-in the harbour of her birth.
ROY SAUNGERS The Raising of the 'Vasa' from The Listener
